notes.title: The best game you missed in October 2020: Mesmer
notes.content:
As 2020 goes kicking and screaming into that good night, we’ve rounded up some of the best games from the year that we didn’t end up covering. Check the Best Game You Missed tag for more.

We are living, we are constantly told, through unprecedented times. Years like 2020 are the kind of years that make me think things like “woah, we are living through history, like, all the time“, like a stoned 20-year-old gap year dude coming to self awareness for the first time in his life.

In Mesmer you get to be the history maker, in an old-world, European-esque city that is ruled over by a corrupt monarchy. Leading a revolution and storming the castle is, as it turns out, quite difficult, and requires a complex balancing act.

(more…)

notes.title: Mesmer is now Live!
notes.content:
Mesmer is finally here. After 3 years of work we're excited to finally bring the game to you. 

We want to thank everyone who has supported us on our road to here, we really appreciate it and we hope you enjoy what we've made!

notes.title: Mesmer Dev Stream
notes.content: Peter (Rain Games CEO) and Aslak (Rain Games Animator and Artist) will be streaming Mesmer today at 7:30PM CEST. They'll be answering questions while dishing out all the details on the game's development and what you can expect from the game.

notes.title: The best free demos from the Steam Autumn Festival
notes.content:
Steam returns with actual hundreds of free demos for its Autumn Festival. I am but one woman, so I could never get through them all, but I have played what I would characterise as a lot over the past two days. My own personal labour of Hercules was undertaken so that I could bring you, the reader, a list of my favourite demos to provide, if not an exhaustive list, then at least a jumping off point.

I’ve got something for all of yez, gentle pals. Puzzle games? RPGs? Action? Strategy? Why yes, even that. I’ve got an EDM murder rave, dressing up in pre-revolutionary Paris, ripping up legal documents as a cute turnip, and rodents you should live in fear of. So many games! Your favourite is sure to be among them.

(more…)

notes.title: What's is Mesmer?
notes.content:
In Mesmer you take the role of a revolutionary leader, winning the people to your side through any method of your choosing! From kind tasks and charming persuasion to blackmail and bribery, the choice is completely up to you!

However, every action moves the clock forward, and if you get to the end of the day without enough influence, you're doomed! This means every choice matters, so choose wisely!

Oh! And If you need some extra dirt, you can always sneak into people's home at night while breaking the cities curfew, but you'll have to be stealthy as the night watch is about!

[previewyoutube=UCu2g3uF-Xw;full][/previewyoutube]

In the demo, you get to access the first 2 days of game-play and all the possibilities available. Try it out!
